question: how tight is the crude balance and what does Wednesday's EIA report usually do?

balance_view.text: US commercial crude stocks sit 2.1 sd below the 5-year same-week average [s10] (-3.7% [s9]), with days of supply at 25.0 against 27.5 [s13] [s14]. The latest week drew 3,060 kbbl against a seasonal norm of 66.8 [s11] [s12]. The hub disagrees: Cushing is 13.7% above its 5-year average [s16] and 15.4% above its trailing 52-week mean [s20] (weak seasonality). Flows lean tight too: implied product demand is 3.0% above the same weeks of the prior five years [s28] and refinery crude inputs 5.5% above [s30].
